output.english_question: On 15 Oct 2025, at the time of the interest rate reset, is UCB (Tier 3) required to offer EMI-based personal loan borrowers an option to switch to a fixed rate?

RBI guidelines interest rate reset option fixed rate switch personal loan EMI based

premises: UCB has a Tier 3 category for its borrowers/products.
The loan is an EMI-based personal loan (non-business).
There is an interest rate reset event on 15 Oct 2025.
The question concerns whether a fixed-rate switch option must be offered at that reset time.
